sources.note: 1.17.0.0 game-file-derived index: 71 entries, level IDs, families, properties, built-ins, packs, and Soul requirement.
Secondary display definition: 73 known Armors, 71 obtainable, 41 unique, seven seasonal.
Ender/Curious and Soul Mage Robe unused context; Soul Mage Robe is outside the 73-item Gear list.
Vanguard Armor level ID DesertArmor is mob equipment.
Armor card +X health and low-Power min/max table.
Two Power 251 Armor pieces reported with different displayed health bonuses.

populationReconciliation.projectPopulationDefinition: Normalized union of the dungeons.tools 1.17.0.0 Armor index and the Minecraft Wiki 73-item known Armor display list. Includes hero-unobtainable Ender Armor and Vanguard Armor as research records; excludes conceptual file remnants not present in either reconciled list.

scopeExclusions.reason: Unused file-remnant concept documented by the Wiki but absent from both the 71-entry primary index and the Wiki 73-item known Gear list.
